title: Keeping Company
description: A real-estate broker (Frank Morgan) and his wife advise the eldest (Ann Rutherford) of their three daughters about marriage.

title: Two O'Clock Courage
description: An amnesiac murder suspect (Tom Conway) meets a woman cabby (Ann Rutherford) who helps him figure it all out.

title: King of Jazz
description: This lost film found in 1970 features dance numbers, pioneer special effects, animation, the Rhythm Boys with Bing Crosby.

title: Hollywood Canteen
description: A GI (Robert Hutton) back from the South Pacific wins a canteen raffle and meets his dream girl (Joan Leslie), as Warner Bros. stars perform.

title: Thank Your Lucky Stars
description: A Hollywood tour-bus guide (Eddie Cantor) joins a wartime revue with Joan Leslie, Bette Davis, Errol Flynn and Warner Bros. stars.

title: Thousands Cheer
description: A colonel's daughter loves a private and puts on an Army show with Mickey Rooney, Judy Garland and the MGM stars.

title: Private Buckaroo
description: Nightclub performers (The Andrews Sisters, Dick Foran, Joe E. Lewis) do Army shows with Harry James and His Music Makers.

title: Two Girls and a Sailor
description: A sailor (Van Johnson) from a rich family meets a nightclub-singing sister act (June Allyson, Gloria DeHaven) in wartime New York.

title: That Midnight Kiss
description: A Philadelphia debutante (Kathryn Grayson) talks her opera maestro (Jose Iturbi) into giving a GI tenor (Mario Lanza) a chance.

title: Holiday in Mexico
description: The U.S. ambassador's (Walter Pidgeon) daughter falls for a Mexican pianist (Jose Iturbi) old enough to be her grandfather.

title: His Majesty O'Keefe
description: A sea captain (Burt Lancaster) marries an islander (Joan Rice) and becomes a South Pacific king of dried coconut meat.

title: South Sea Woman
description: A World War II Marine (Burt Lancaster) tells a court-martial where he, his buddy (Chuck Connors) and a nightclub camera-girl (Virginia Mayo) have been.

title: The Flame and the Arrow
description: An acrobatic rebel (Burt Lancaster) and his band of mountain men trick Hessian mercenaries in medieval Italy.

title: The Crimson Pirate
description: An acrobatic pirate (Burt Lancaster) and his sidekick (Nick Cravat) help Caribbean rebels fight Spain with an inventor's weapons.

title: The Killers
description: An insurance investigator (Edmond O'Brien) finds a woman (Ava Gardner) behind an ex-boxer's (Burt Lancaster) murder.

title: Sorry, Wrong Number
description: A bedridden heiress (Barbara Stanwyck) phones her husband (Burt Lancaster) and overhears two men plotting a murder.

title: Criss Cross
description: An armored-car guard (Burt Lancaster) must join a robbery after being caught with his ex-wife (Yvonne De Carlo) by her gangster husband (Dan Duryea).

title: Kiss the Blood Off My Hands
description: A blackmailer (Robert Newton) hounds a World War II veteran (Burt Lancaster) hiding from the police with a nurse (Joan Fontaine) in London.

title: Brute Force
description: Hatred for a sadistic captain (Hume Cronyn) drives a convict (Burt Lancaster) and his cellmates to escape.

title: 40 Takes Willy
description: A documentary about acclaimed film director William Wyler.

title: Blonde Crazy
description: A hotel bellhop (James Cagney) and his girlfriend (Joan Blondell) work con games, then are conned by a con man (Louis Calhern) themselves.

title: Colleen
description: A millionaire's nephew (Dick Powell) saves him from a gold digger and falls for a woman (Ruby Keeler) in a dress shop.

title: The Public Enemy
description: Two hoodlums, Tom and Matt, rise up from their poverty-stricken slum life to become petty thieves, bootleggers and cold-blooded killers. But with street notoriety and newfound wealth, the duo feels the heat from the cops and rival gangsters both.

title: A Midsummer Night's Dream
description: Shakespeare's Puck (Mickey Rooney) and forest fairies prompt a triple mortal wedding, with entertainment by Bottom (James Cagney).

title: Dames
description: A chorus girl (Joan Blondell), producer (Dick Powell) and dancer (Ruby Keeler) put on a Broadway show. Choreographed by Busby Berkeley.

title: Gold Diggers of 1933
description: A songwriter's (Dick Powell) big check puts chorus girls (Joan Blondell, Ruby Keeler) to work but incurs his brother's wrath.

title: 42nd Street
description: A Broadway producer (Warner Baxter) sends in the understudy (Ruby Keeler) when his show's star (Bebe Daniels) twists her ankle.

title: Footlight Parade
description: A director (James Cagney) creates and stages extravagant musical prologues for movie theaters.

title: Arsenic and Old Lace
description: A theater critic (Cary Grant) learns his two elderly aunts serve poisoned elderberry wine to lonely gentlemen callers.

title: State of the Union
description: An heiress (Angela Lansbury) wants a self-made man (Spencer Tracy) to run for president with his estranged wife (Katharine Hepburn) by his side.

title: Ladies of Leisure
description: Wealthy artist Jerry Strong asks a striking call-girl to pose for him, but their budding relationship is complicated by his friend and his interfering parents.

title: Mr. Deeds Goes to Town
description: A folksy New England poet (Gary Cooper) inherits $20 million he doesn't want and tells a New York newswoman (Jean Arthur) why.

title: Small Town Girl
description: A New England miss (Janet Gaynor) meets a rich stranger (Robert Taylor) who's surprised the next morning to hear they got married.

title: The Strawberry Blonde
description: An ex-convict dentist (James Cagney) recalls his wife (Olivia de Havilland) and another man's wife (Rita Hayworth), in circa-1900 New York.

title: Flower Drum Song
description: Residents (Nancy Kwan, James Shigeta, Miyoshi Umeki) of San Francisco's Chinatown mix East with West in custom and culture, ending with a double wedding.

title: Camelot
description: King Arthur (Richard Harris) loses Guinevere (Vanessa Redgrave) to trusted Sir Lancelot (Franco Nero) in the colorful court of Camelot.

title: An American in Paris
description: An American soldier (Gene Kelly) stays in Paris after World War II to paint and falls in love with a French beauty (Leslie Caron).

title: Top Hat
description: A woman (Ginger Rogers) believes that an enamored dancer (Fred Astaire) is her best friend's husband.

title: West Side Story
description: Against a backdrop of vicious gang warfare between the New Yorker Jets and the Puerto Rican Sharks, a romance develops across rival lines. 1960s update of "Romeo and Juliet", with amazing song and dance sequences.

title: Places in the Heart
description: A widowed mother fights for her cotton farm with a laborer and a blind boarder in the 1930s Texas.

title: Absence of Malice
description: A federal bureaucrat (Bob Balaban) leads a Miami newswoman (Sally Field) to libel a dead gangster's honest son (Paul Newman).

title: Smokey and the Bandit
description: Sheriff Buford T. Justice (Jackie Gleason) chases a trucker, his buddy (Burt Reynolds), a runaway bride (Sally Field) and 400 cases of beer.

title: Hooper
description: An upstart (Jan-Michael Vincent) pushes a veteran Hollywood stuntman (Burt Reynolds), daring him to try a new stunt.

title: Murphy's Romance
description: A divorced mother (Sally Field) moves to an Arizona ranch and meets a widowed pharmacist (James Garner) twice her age.

title: Doughboys
description: A privileged and affluent young man mistakenly enlists in the military, hoping to win the heart of a beautiful USO performer.
